messages:
Elena: Hey team — acme POC (tenant: acme-trial) started seeing a lot of 429s on /v1/embeddings and /v1/chat.generate since 10:20 PST. Demo in 45m. Anyone around? :grimacing:
Arjun: On it. Are these client-side retries or upstream 429? Can you paste response headers?
Elena: Quick paste:
```
HTTP/1.1 429 Too Many Requests
x-rate-limit-tenant: 120/60
x-route-cap: embeddings:10,chat.generate:5
x-request-id: r-12f3
{
  "error": "quota_exceeded",
  "detail": "burst window exceeded"
}
```
Mike: x-rate-limit-tenant looks like tenant-level steady budget 120/min. But per-route cap is low; embeddings returning 429 when parallel import job + interactive demo run.
Sofia: Did they spin up bulk import? That can blow token budget quickly if each item uses 3k tokens. Elena, can you confirm concurrency and average tokens per request?
Elena: Import job uses 8 workers, ~2k tokens/request. Interactive client does 6 simultaneous demo requests.
Arjun: math: 8*2k + 6*2k = 28k tokens/period. Our token accounting converts to units? Might be hitting token budget (per-minute). Also per-route cap (embeddings:10) triggers when >10 concurrent embeddings. The logs show concurrent spikes of 14.
Sofia: Proposal: temporarily raise per-route cap for this tenant to 25 for next 1h and throttle import to 2 workers. That keeps demo live. Would need approval from infra to bump.
Mike: I'm ok to bump for 60m. We need to add a quick guard (auto revert) and note on billing. @OpsBot can you run `tenant adjust-cap acme-trial --route embeddings --concurrency 25 --expires 60m` ?
OpsBot: Command received: adjusting capacity... will revert in 60m. Audit id: audit-255555A
Elena: Patch applied, demo team confirms 429s stopped. :tada:
Sofia: After demo, recommend the following: 1) add client-side concurrency cap for interactive 4, 2) schedule import as off-peak with rate-limited workers, 3) re-evaluate committed tokens for Dedicated plan. I'll send a short runbook.
Arjun: Also flag for product: allow on-the-fly short-lived cap bumps for presales flows with approval and auto-revert.
Elena: Thanks all. Will follow up with customer note and attach logs. Closing once post-demo smoke passes. :thumbsup:
Mike: Closing in 1h if no regressions.
Elena: last: audit id and snippet for security QA: `audit-255555A --actor OpsBot --reason presales-demo-bump`
